snippet.title: SLACKJAW Out Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
"SLACKJAW" now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073900/SLACKJAW/ 

Listen to the Soundtrack here: https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/taylorambrosiowood/slackjaw-original-game-soundtrack

About the game: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive in this atmospheric first-person escape room-style horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events.

All music composed, produced, mixed, and mastered by Taylor Ambrosio Wood

Socials: Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/r47gmJ3z6R 
Website: https://www.taylorambrosiowood.com/nostromo 
Support: https://ko-fi.com/nostromo 

© 2025 Nostromo Interactive LLC
